Task 2 · The Creative Visionary 🎨

Cyberpunk-Corporate
Brand Asset System

High-fidelity, brand-consistent visual assets for a tech startup rebrand — generated using AI image models with advanced prompting techniques.

By Aisha Tariq Khan

📋 Task Overview

Scenario: A tech startup is rebranding and needs high-quality visual assets for its website and social media. Stock photos are too generic. They need a unique "Cyberpunk-Corporate" aesthetic consistent across all images.

Mission:

  • Generate high-fidelity, brand-consistent visual assets using Image Gen Models
  • Develop a series of 5 images using Advanced Prompting — negative prompts, aspect ratios, and lighting styles
  • Perform Image-to-Image translations to keep the same character consistent across different scenes
Midjourney DALL-E 3 Stable Diffusion Img2Img Negative Prompts Aspect Ratios Lighting Styles
Asset 01

Logo Concept

Female silhouette inside a hexagonal frame with glowing cyan AR glasses — the core brand mark.

Primary brand mark
1:1 ratio DALL-E 3
🎨 Prompt
female silhouette inside hexagon, glowing cyan AR smart glasses, corporate blazer with neon violet outline, minimalist logo mark, deep dark navy background, purple geometric facets, flat vector style, no text --ar 1:1 --style raw --q 2

Negative: realistic photo, busy background, gradients, drop shadows, serif fonts, text, watermark, 3D render
⚙️ Technique
· Aspect ratio: 1:1 — square, app-icon safe
· Lighting: neon rim light + ambient violet fill
· Seeded from character reference via Img2Img
· Negative prompts to remove noise and clutter
Asset 02

Hero Image

Editorial-grade website hero — consistent character, cinematic depth of field, cyan-violet ambient lighting.

Website hero banner — same character, grey pinstripe blazer, glowing AR glasses, futuristic office
3:4 ratio Cinematic bokeh Stable Diffusion XL
🎨 Prompt
professional Asian woman wearing glowing cyan AR smart glasses, grey pinstripe blazer with circuit-dot stitching, standing in futuristic corporate office, neon blue and pink ambient lighting, holographic displays in background, cinematic depth of field, 8K photorealistic --ar 3:4 --style raw --q 2

Negative: cartoon, anime, low quality, overexposed, cluttered, text overlay, watermark, deformed hands, extra limbs
Asset 03

Icon Sets

Two thematic icon sets in consistent neon-glow style — identity objects and professional tools.

Set 1 — Identity icons
Glasses · Blazer · ChairDALL-E 3
🎨 Prompt
3 app icons, glowing white neon outline, dark navy-to-purple gradient, rounded square, AR glasses / corporate blazer / office chair, cyberpunk corporate style --ar 3:1

Negative: 3D, realistic, text, shadows, inconsistent style
Set 2 — Tools icons
Laptop · Chart · WrenchDALL-E 3
🎨 Prompt
3 app icons, glowing cyan neon outline, dark navy-to-purple gradient, rounded square, laptop / presentation wand with bars / wrench, cyberpunk corporate style --ar 3:1

Negative: 3D, realistic, text, shadows, inconsistent style
Asset 04

Social Media Post

Wide-format banner — same character at a holographic workstation with neon diagonal composition.

Platform banner — consistent character, holographic laptop, cyan & violet neon rays
16:9 ratio Midjourney
🎨 Prompt
same woman from reference, seated at glowing holographic transparent laptop, cyan and violet neon light rays diagonal composition, dark deep blue background, futuristic AI chat bubbles floating, cinematic lighting --ar 16:9 --style raw --q 2

Negative: daylight, natural light, realistic office, crowded, logos, watermarks, text artifacts, deformed hands
Asset 05

Brand Consistency Sheet

All assets composed together — proving cross-scene character consistency, palette lock, and prop continuity.

Consistent elements across all assets

  • Same character model across all scenes
  • Grey pinstripe blazer prop locked
  • Glowing cyan AR glasses in every shot
  • Cyan + violet neon color palette
  • Dark background maintained throughout
  • Futuristic tech environment theme

Advanced prompting techniques applied

  • Img2Img for cross-scene character consistency
  • Negative prompts applied on every asset
  • Custom aspect ratios per platform use-case
  • Cinematic lighting style locked as reference
  • --style raw for photorealistic quality
  • Seed pinning to maintain character continuity
